name: Makoto-sensei no Junan: Heart Plus
original_name: まこと先生の受難 ハートプラス
source:
Makoto Hiiragi, a teacher at the private Seigunkan Academy, ends up in a freak accident that transforms him into a beautiful woman.
This time, as a mini-story, the author brings together his stepsister, Yume, who lives with him; the beautiful school nurse next door, Haruka; a timid male student, Yuu; along with the suspicious chemistry teacher, Reiji, and the gorilla-like gym teacher, Masuo—all dragged into the chaos.
The trials and tribulations of Makoto-sensei—Heart Plus is now in session!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ128568.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
私立青军馆教师柊诚因一场离奇事故而变成了一位美丽的女人。
这次，作为一个迷你故事，作者聚集了与他同住的继妹，Yume；隔壁美丽的学校护士Haruka；胆小的男学生优；加上可疑的化学老师礼二，还有大猩猩般的体育老师玛雄——都被卷入了混乱之中。
诚老师的考验与磨难——Heart Plus开课啦！
